classes.objetivo: Reconocer y formar sustantivos abstractos a partir de verbos y adjetivos (decide → decision, kind → kindness) y leerlos en un texto breve.

ensenanza.en: The committee's refusal to publish the accounts damaged public trust and raised serious doubts about its transparency.
ensenanza.es: La negativa del comité a publicar las cuentas dañó la confianza pública y suscitó serias dudas sobre su transparencia.
ensenanza.nota: refuse → refusal y transparent → transparency: la nominalización deja la idea como protagonista y oculta quién se negó.

ensenanza.en: It took the board three long meetings to reach a decision on the development of the old harbour.
ensenanza.es: El consejo necesitó tres reuniones largas para tomar una decisión sobre el desarrollo del antiguo puerto.
ensenanza.nota: reach a decision es la colocación natural (no «take»); develop → development añade -ment al verbo.

ensenanza.en: Customers rarely praise reliability in a supplier, yet a single failure to deliver on time can cost a firm its best contract.
ensenanza.es: Los clientes rara vez elogian la fiabilidad de un proveedor, pero un solo fallo en la entrega puede costarle a una empresa su mejor contrato.
ensenanza.nota: reliable → reliability (-able → -ability) y fail → failure (-ure): failure to + verbo nombra lo que no se logró.

ensenanza.en: On arrival, visitors noticed a marked improvement in the signage, and several remarked on the kindness of the volunteers.
ensenanza.es: A su llegada, los visitantes notaron una mejora notable en la señalización, y varios comentaron la amabilidad de los voluntarios.
ensenanza.nota: on arrival es una fórmula fija de informes; kind → kindness y improve → improvement (-ness, -ment).

ensenanza.en: Sustained growth rests on reliability rather than on dramatic breakthroughs, and the difference usually shows after a decade.
ensenanza.es: El crecimiento sostenido se apoya en la fiabilidad más que en avances espectaculares, y la diferencia suele verse después de una década.
ensenanza.nota: grow → growth tiene forma propia; differ → difference usa -ence: cada pareja se aprende entera.

ensenanza.en: The late departure of the delegation caused little disruption, but the difference in tone between the two speeches was striking.
ensenanza.es: La salida tardía de la delegación causó pocas molestias, pero la diferencia de tono entre los dos discursos fue llamativa.
ensenanza.nota: depart → departure (-ure); el sustantivo puede llevar adjetivo delante (late departure) y of después.

explicacion.titulo: De verbos y adjetivos a sustantivos
explicacion.texto: En inglés formal las acciones y las cualidades se nombran como cosas: en vez de «we refused», the refusal. Es la nominalización: condensa y suena objetiva, pero suele ocultar quién actúa. Cada terminación tiene su grupo: -ion (decide → decision), -ment (improve → improvement), -ness (kind → kindness), -ity o -cy (reliable → reliability, transparent → transparency), -al (arrive → arrival), -ure (fail → failure), -ence (differ → difference), o una forma propia (grow → growth). Aprende cada pareja entera.

formula.nota: verbo base: lo que alguien hace

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: There is a big different between the two offers.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: There is a big difference between the two offers.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Different es un adjetivo: después de big hace falta el sustantivo difference.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: Reliable matters more than speed in a small shop.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: Reliability matters more than speed in a small shop.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Un adjetivo no puede ser sujeto: se convierte en el sustantivo reliability.

situacion.contexto: Ana y Leo preparan el boletín de su barrio y cambian algunas frases para que suenen más formales.

dialogo.texto: Look at this sentence: We decided to close the garden.
dialogo.traduccion: Mira esta frase: Decidimos cerrar el jardín.

dialogo.texto: It is correct, but the newsletter needs a formal style. Try: The decision to close the garden surprised many neighbours.
dialogo.traduccion: Es correcta, pero el boletín necesita un estilo formal. Prueba: La decisión de cerrar el jardín sorprendió a muchos vecinos.

dialogo.texto: And this one? Our neighbours were kind, and the move was easier.
dialogo.traduccion: ¿Y esta? Nuestros vecinos fueron amables y la mudanza fue más fácil.

dialogo.texto: Better: The kindness of our neighbours made the move easier.
dialogo.traduccion: Mejor: La amabilidad de nuestros vecinos facilitó la mudanza.

item.consigna: ¿Qué cambia Leo para que el boletín suene más formal?

opciones.es: Convierte verbos y adjetivos en sustantivos, como decision y kindness.
Quita todos los adjetivos de las frases.

item.feedback: Leo cambia «We decided» por «The decision» y «were kind» por «The kindness»: verbos y adjetivos pasan a sustantivos.

guiada.consigna: Elige el sustantivo que falta en la noticia sobre la biblioteca.
guiada.texto: The ___ to close the library surprised the whole town, because the council had promised only a month earlier to keep it open.
opciones: decision
deciding
decisive
guiada.feedback: Después de The hace falta un sustantivo abstracto: decision (de decide), que lleva to close como complemento.
guiada.pista: Después de The y antes de to close va un sustantivo, no un verbo ni un adjetivo.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «La llegada del nuevo profesor cambió el ambiente de la clase.»
guiada.texto: The ___ of the new teacher changed the mood of the class; pupils who had barely spoken for weeks began to ask questions.
guiada.feedback: Arrival es el sustantivo de arrive (-e → -al) y puede ser el sujeto del verbo changed.
guiada.pista: Es el sustantivo de arrive; el verbo solo no funciona después de The.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «El crecimiento constante del pueblo sorprendió incluso al ayuntamiento local.»
guiada.respuesta: The steady growth of the village surprised even the local council
guiada.feedback: El grupo nominal The steady growth of the village es el sujeto y va antes del verbo surprised.
guiada.pista: El sujeto es un grupo nominal largo; el verbo surprised va después de village.

practica.consigna: Une cada pareja verbo o adjetivo → sustantivo con su significado.
practica.feedback: Cada pareja cambia de forma de manera distinta: -ency, -ure, -al y -ence; conviene aprenderlas enteras.

practica.consigna: Escucha el informe y elige qué salió bien tras el cambio de transportista.
practica.audio: The regional manager's report was blunt. Since the decision to change carrier, the company's growth has slowed for two quarters, and the failure of the first supplier to meet its deadlines did not help. Yet the reliability of the new carrier has been striking: not one parcel has arrived late since the departure of the old driver in October. The manager added that the refusal of the landlord to negotiate had finally forced the company to make a change it should have made years ago.
opciones: The new carrier has not been late with a single parcel.
The first supplier has become the firm's most reliable partner.
Sales have recovered fully after the change of carrier.
practica.feedback: Reliability of the new carrier significa que todos los paquetes llegan a tiempo; el crecimiento, en cambio, se ha frenado.

practica.consigna: Completa cada frase con el sustantivo de la palabra entre paréntesis.
frases: The two sides finally signed an ___ after a month of talks. (agree)
Nobody doubted her ___ as a team leader. (able)
The ___ of the children must always come first. (safe)
practica.feedback: Agree, able y safe forman agreement, ability y safety: -ment, -ity y -ty.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué da a entender el autor del correo sobre el cambio de oficina?
evaluacion.texto: Dear all, the landlord's refusal to accept a new contract leaves us with little choice, but I would not call the decision sudden: the failure of our negotiations has been visible since spring. I ask only that we measure the development of the plan by its transparency, not by its speed, and that nobody treat the departure from the old office as a defeat.
opciones: That the move was expected and should not be read as a loss.
That the landlord alone is to blame and the team should complain.
That speed matters more than honesty in carrying out the plan.
That the old office had been a mistake from the very beginning.
evaluacion.feedback: El autor recuerda que los problemas se veían desde la primavera y pide no vivir la salida como una derrota: la mudanza era previsible.

evaluacion.consigna: Convierte cada palabra en sustantivo para completar las frases.
frases: Her ___ with difficult customers was respected by the whole team. (patient)
Nobody understood the ___ offered for the long delay. (explain)
The ___ of the invoice is due before the end of the month. (pay)
His ___ about the mistake won him the manager's respect. (honest)
evaluacion.feedback: Patient, explain, pay y honest dan patience, explanation, payment y honesty: cada pareja tiene su terminación.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha el pódcast y elige qué actitud muestra la presentadora ante su error.
evaluacion.audio: In the final episode, the host admits that her confidence was a mistake. The growth she predicted never came, and the failure, she says, taught her more than any success. She does not blame the market or her partners; she blames her own refusal to listen to the early warnings that her adviser kept repeating.
opciones: She accepts responsibility and sees the lesson in the failure.
She regrets the failure but mainly blames difficult market conditions.
She feels the failure was unfair and would repeat the same plan.
evaluacion.feedback: No culpa al mercado ni a sus socios: asume su propia negativa a escuchar las advertencias y valora la lección del fracaso.

evaluacion.consigna: Ordena: «La salida repentina del director causó bastante preocupación entre el personal.»
evaluacion.respuesta: The sudden departure of the manager caused serious concern among the staff
evaluacion.feedback: El sujeto es el grupo nominal The sudden departure of the manager; caused es el verbo principal.

repaso.consigna: Escucha el fragmento de la reunión y elige con qué intención habla la directora.
repaso.audio: Let me be honest about the figures. The improvement in our delivery times is real, but I would not celebrate yet. A single week of good results is not sustained growth, and the departure of two experienced drivers could ruin everything within a month. So my request is simple: keep the reliability of the past month, and tell me early if anything starts to go wrong.
opciones: To urge the team to stay cautious and report problems early.
To announce that the delivery problems have now been solved.
To blame the two drivers who decided to leave the firm.
repaso.feedback: Reconoce la mejora pero advierte de que no es crecimiento sostenido y pide avisar pronto: busca prudencia, no celebración ni reproches.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «La auditoría halló una mejora notable en las cuentas de la empresa.»
repaso.texto: The audit found a ___ improvement in the firm's accounts: costs were lower, errors had fallen and the reports were finally on time.
repaso.feedback: Marked improvement es la colocación formal para una mejora claramente visible.

repaso.consigna: ¿Con qué propósito usa la autora tantas nominalizaciones en el informe?
repaso.texto: The refusal of the board to reveal the figures led to a loss of confidence. The departure of two directors followed, and the failure of the investigation to name anyone has left the question of responsibility open.
opciones: To keep an impersonal tone that leaves the responsible people unnamed.
To show that the board revealed the figures to everyone involved.
To blame the two directors who had left for the whole crisis.
To praise the investigation for naming those who were responsible.
repaso.feedback: Refusal, departure y failure convierten acciones en cosas: el texto suena objetivo y nunca dice quién decidió, salió o falló.

classes.objetivo: Construir grupos nominales largos con la preposición fija de cada nominalización (a reduction in, demand for, a solution to) y usar due to y as a result of delante de un grupo nominal.

ensenanza.en: The council reported a sharp reduction in air pollution last year, and a steep increase in the number of cyclists seems to explain it.
ensenanza.es: El ayuntamiento informó de una fuerte reducción de la contaminación del aire el año pasado, y un aumento pronunciado del número de ciclistas parece explicarla.
ensenanza.nota: reduction + in: in introduce lo que disminuye; increase in + lo que sube (con cifra: an increase of ten per cent).

ensenanza.en: A lack of qualified drivers forced the company to cut evening services, even though demand for them had never been higher.
ensenanza.es: La falta de conductores calificados obligó a la empresa a recortar los servicios de la tarde, aunque la demanda de estos nunca había sido mayor.
ensenanza.nota: lack of y demand for: la preposición no siempre coincide con el español («demanda de» = demand for).

ensenanza.en: The authorities need a solution to the flooding, because the storm did serious damage to the bridges and to several roads.
ensenanza.es: Las autoridades necesitan una solución a las inundaciones, porque la tormenta causó graves daños en los puentes y en varias carreteras.
ensenanza.nota: a solution to y damage to: en inglés estos nombres se construyen con to, no con of.

ensenanza.en: In response to the complaints, the manager promised that the damage to the firm's reputation would be repaired, but a knock-on effect on delivery times seems likely.
ensenanza.es: En respuesta a las quejas, el director prometió que se repararía el daño a la reputación de la empresa, pero parece probable un efecto en cadena sobre los plazos de entrega.
ensenanza.nota: in response to + grupo nominal; a knock-on effect on: el efecto indirecto de algo que ya ocurrió.

ensenanza.en: Due to the heavy snow the match was moved, and owing to a shortfall in ticket sales the club blamed a lack of public interest.
ensenanza.es: Debido a la fuerte nevada el partido se aplazó, y a causa de un déficit en la venta de entradas el club culpó a la falta de interés del público.
ensenanza.nota: due to y owing to van delante de un grupo nominal (the heavy snow), nunca de una oración con verbo conjugado.

ensenanza.en: As a result of the delay, many fans left early, and the effect on local shops was a reduction in takings that nobody had predicted.
ensenanza.es: Como resultado del retraso, muchos aficionados se marcharon temprano, y el efecto en los comercios locales fue una reducción de la recaudación que nadie había previsto.
ensenanza.nota: as a result of + grupo nominal (the delay); effect on + quién o qué resulta afectado.

explicacion.texto: Las nominalizaciones llevan una preposición fija y conviene aprenderlas en bloque: a reduction in, an increase in (o of + cifra), a lack of, demand for, a solution to, damage to, a response to, an effect on, a shortfall in. No siempre coinciden con el español: «demanda de» es demand for y «efecto en» es effect on. Además, due to, owing to y as a result of van delante de un grupo nominal, no de un verbo conjugado: due to the rain, no «due to it rained». El grupo puede crecer: a sharp reduction in energy costs.

patron.texto: Nominalización + preposición fija + lo que cambia:

formula.nota: preposición fija: cada nombre tiene la suya
due to + grupo nominal, no una oración

filas.texto: an increase of ten per cent

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The town needs a solution of the flooding.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The town needs a solution to the flooding.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Con solution se usa to, no of: a solution to + el problema.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: Due to it rained all day, the match was moved.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: Due to the rain, the match was moved.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Due to va seguido de un grupo nominal (the rain), no de una oración con verbo.

situacion.contexto: Tom y Sara leen un aviso de la compañía de autobuses de su barrio.

dialogo.texto: The notice says: due to a lack of drivers, there is a reduction in evening buses.
dialogo.traduccion: El aviso dice: por la falta de conductores, hay menos autobuses por la tarde.

dialogo.texto: So the demand for buses is not the problem?
dialogo.traduccion: ¿Entonces la demanda de autobuses no es el problema?

dialogo.texto: No. The demand for evening buses is high. The solution to the problem is to find more drivers.
dialogo.traduccion: No. La demanda de autobuses por la tarde es alta. La solución al problema es encontrar más conductores.

dialogo.texto: Then I hope the company finds a solution soon.
dialogo.traduccion: Entonces espero que la compañía encuentre una solución pronto.

item.consigna: Según Tom, ¿cuál es el problema de los autobuses de la tarde?

opciones.es: Nadie quiere viajar por la tarde.

item.feedback: Tom lee: «due to a lack of drivers»: hay menos autobuses porque faltan conductores.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «Hubo una fuerte reducción del ruido en la zona.»
guiada.texto: Residents have welcomed the new road. There has been a sharp reduction ___ noise in the area, and the fact that heavy lorries now use the ring road is the main reason.
guiada.feedback: Reduction se une con in: a reduction in noise indica qué es lo que baja.
guiada.pista: Cada nombre lleva su preposición: aquí indica en qué cambió algo.

guiada.consigna: Elige el grupo nominal correcto para «falta de agua» en el texto.
guiada.texto: The village had no rain for three months. By August the wells were almost empty, and everybody in the valley was talking about ___.
opciones: a lack of water
a lack for water
a lack in water
guiada.feedback: Lack va siempre con of: a lack of water, igual que a lack of time.
guiada.pista: Es la preposición más frecuente para unir dos nombres en inglés.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «Por un déficit de financiación, el museo cerró dos salas.»
guiada.respuesta: Owing to a shortfall in funding the museum closed two galleries
aceptadas: The museum closed two galleries owing to a shortfall in funding
Owing to a shortfall in funding, the museum closed two galleries
guiada.feedback: Owing to va delante del grupo nominal a shortfall in funding y la oración principal sigue después.
guiada.pista: Empieza con Owing to y un grupo nominal; después viene la oración principal.

practica.consigna: Completa cada grupo nominal con la preposición fija.
frases: The demand ___ electric bikes has grown sharply since the new law.
The storm caused serious damage ___ the roof of the old theatre.
Her response ___ the news was calm, almost cold.
The new rule had an unexpected effect ___ small shops.
practica.feedback: Demand for, damage to, response to y effect on son combinaciones fijas que no siempre coinciden con el español.

practica.consigna: Escucha la noticia de radio y elige por qué se recortaron los trenes de la tarde.
practica.audio: Commuters will face longer journeys this winter. Owing to a shortfall in funding, the regional train company has cut its evening services, and in response to the cuts, local companies have complained of a knock-on effect on staff attendance: some workers now leave early to catch the last train, while others no longer come at all. The company insists that demand for late trains is low, but passengers say the lack of a reliable service is what keeps them away. A solution to the conflict now depends on the council.
opciones: Evening services were reduced because funding fell short.
Evening services were reduced because few people use them.
Evening services were reduced because local companies complained.
practica.feedback: El recorte se debe al déficit de financiación; que la demanda sea baja es lo que dice la empresa, no la causa que da la noticia.

practica.consigna: Une cada grupo nominal con su equivalente en español.
pares: un fuerte aumento de los alquileres
un efecto en cadena sobre los precios
practica.feedback: Las preposiciones cambian respecto al español: in, on, to y in aparecen donde en español va «de» o «sobre».

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «Debido a la fuerte nevada, el campo no se podía usar.»
evaluacion.texto: The match was called off at the last minute. ___ the heavy snow, the pitch was too wet to play on, and the club now faces a loss of ticket income.
evaluacion.feedback: Due to, owing to, because of y as a result of introducen un grupo nominal (the heavy snow), nunca un verbo conjugado.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué actitud muestra la directora ante la queja de los viajeros?
evaluacion.texto: Thank you for your letter. I accept that the reduction in evening services has caused difficulty, and I do not question the demand for them. However, there was a shortfall in our budget, and the damage to our accounts left us no alternative. A solution to the problem may come next spring, but I cannot promise it.
opciones: Understanding, but reluctant to promise any change.
Dismissive of the complaint, which she calls unfair.
Apologetic, and ready to bring the trains back at once.
Defensive, and sure that the demand is exaggerated.
evaluacion.feedback: Reconoce la dificultad y la demanda, pero se limita a decir que quizá haya una solución en primavera y no la promete.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha la noticia y elige qué da a entender sobre la postura de la alcaldesa.
evaluacion.audio: An increase of five per cent in food prices has had a serious effect on many families, and charities report a steep rise in requests for help. Yet the mayor insists that the figures exaggerate the problem, and claims that salaries have risen faster than prices.
opciones: She doubts that the problem is as serious as the charities say.
She agrees that families now need urgent help from the state.
She expects food prices to fall back to their old level soon.
evaluacion.feedback: Al afirmar que las cifras exageran el problema y que los salarios suben más que los precios, la alcaldesa pone en duda la gravedad que describen las organizaciones.

evaluacion.consigna: Ordena: «Un fuerte aumento de los alquileres afectó mucho a las tiendas pequeñas.»
evaluacion.respuesta: A steep increase in rents had a serious effect on small shops
evaluacion.feedback: El sujeto es A steep increase in rents; had a serious effect on introduce lo afectado.

repaso.consigna: ¿Qué sugiere el aviso sobre los sábados junto al mercado?
repaso.texto: Notice: As a result of the building work, there is a reduction in parking near the market. Traders have welcomed the new car park, but they warn that the demand for spaces will be greater than the supply on Saturdays. The council hopes that a shuttle bus will provide a solution to the problem.
opciones: That the new car park may still prove too small.
That the market will close on Saturdays during the work.
That the shuttle bus will be free for all customers.
That traders want the car park to be removed.
repaso.feedback: Si la demanda de espacios va a superar la oferta, el estacionamiento nuevo puede quedarse pequeño los sábados; el aviso no dice nada del mercado ni del precio del autobús.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Hay una gran demanda de clases de inglés en la ciudad.»
repaso.texto: There is a big ___ for English classes in the city, and several schools have had to open extra evening groups.
repaso.feedback: Demand for nombra el interés del público por algo; se une con for, no con of.

repaso.consigna: Ordena: «La falta de conductores tuvo un efecto en cadena en todo el sistema.»
repaso.respuesta: The lack of drivers had a knock-on effect on the whole system
repaso.feedback: The lack of drivers es el sujeto; a knock-on effect on the whole system nombra la consecuencia.

classes.objetivo: Desmontar frases densas con sustantivos abstractos: volver al verbo, recuperar quién hace qué y reformular con verbos claros.

ensenanza.en: The introduction of free lunches led to a steady rise in attendance, yet the report never says who took the decision.
ensenanza.es: La introducción de comidas gratuitas llevó a un aumento constante de la asistencia, pero el informe nunca dice quién tomó la decisión.
ensenanza.nota: introduction y attendance esconden acciones (alguien introdujo, más alumnos asistieron) y el agente no aparece.

ensenanza.en: The closure of the clinic prompted residents to voice concerns, although the notice did not reveal who had ordered it.
ensenanza.es: El cierre de la clínica llevó a los vecinos a expresar sus preocupaciones, aunque el aviso no reveló quién lo había ordenado.
ensenanza.nota: closure oculta al agente: alguien cerró la clínica. voice concerns es la colocación para expresar inquietudes en público.

ensenanza.en: Approval of the plan came only after the council agreed to launch an investigation into a serious complaint about safety.
ensenanza.es: La aprobación del plan llegó solo después de que el ayuntamiento aceptara abrir una investigación sobre una queja grave de seguridad.
ensenanza.nota: approval, investigation y complaint vuelven a los verbos approve, investigate y complain; launch an investigation es la colocación habitual.

ensenanza.en: A decrease in complaints followed the publication of the results, which the press described as a victory for accountability.
ensenanza.es: Una disminución de las quejas siguió a la publicación de los resultados, que la prensa describió como una victoria de la rendición de cuentas.
ensenanza.nota: decrease y publication esconden acciones; accountability nombra quién debe responder de lo que hizo.

ensenanza.en: To unpack a dense sentence, find the abstract noun, return to its verb and ask who performed the action.
ensenanza.es: Para desmontar una frase densa, localiza el sustantivo abstracto, vuelve a su verbo y pregunta quién realizó la acción.
ensenanza.nota: unpack resume el método: sustantivo → verbo → agente. Si el texto no dice quién actúa, no lo inventes.

ensenanza.en: The council closed the clinic after a heated discussion, so residents demanded accountability for a decision nobody had explained.
ensenanza.es: El ayuntamiento cerró la clínica tras una discusión acalorada, así que los vecinos exigieron rendición de cuentas por una decisión que nadie había explicado.
ensenanza.nota: Versión con verbos: ahora aparecen el agente (the council) y la acción (closed the clinic).

explicacion.texto: Los informes y los textos académicos condensan la información: «The closure of the clinic caused concern» ahorra palabras, pero no dice quién cerró la clínica. Para desmontarlo: (1) localiza el sustantivo abstracto (closure); (2) vuelve al verbo (close); (3) recupera el agente: ¿quién lo hizo? (the council); (4) reescribe con verbos y personas. Si el texto no dice quién actúa, no lo inventes: señala que esa información falta. Esa ausencia puede ser un descuido o una forma de eludir la responsabilidad.

formula.nota: sustantivo denso: no dice quién cerró
→ residents felt worried: también se desmonta

filas.texto: The closure of the clinic caused concern
The council closed the clinic, so residents worried.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The closure of the clinics cause concern among residents.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The closure of the clinics causes concern among residents.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: El verbo concuerda con el núcleo (closure, singular), no con el nombre más cercano (clinics).

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: Approval of the plan came after a long investigate.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: Approval of the plan came after a long investigation.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Después del adjetivo long hace falta un sustantivo: investigation, no el verbo investigate.

situacion.contexto: Mia y Carlos leen un informe de su colegio y Mia no entiende una frase.

dialogo.texto: I do not understand this sentence: The introduction of free lunches led to a rise in attendance.
dialogo.traduccion: No entiendo esta frase: La introducción de comidas gratuitas llevó a un aumento de la asistencia.

dialogo.texto: Unpack it. Who introduced the lunches?
dialogo.traduccion: Desmóntala. ¿Quién introdujo las comidas?

dialogo.texto: The school did. So the school introduced free lunches, and more students attended.
dialogo.traduccion: El colegio. Entonces el colegio introdujo comidas gratuitas y asistieron más alumnos.

dialogo.texto: Exactly. The noun hides the agent, but you can find it.
dialogo.traduccion: Exacto. El sustantivo oculta al agente, pero puedes encontrarlo.

item.consigna: ¿Qué hace Mia para entender la frase del informe?

opciones.es: Vuelve a los verbos y descubre que el colegio introdujo las comidas.
Busca todas las palabras nuevas en un diccionario.
Pide a Carlos que escriba el informe otra vez.

item.feedback: Mia dice: «The school introduced free lunches, and more students attended»: vuelve a los verbos y recupera al agente.

guiada.consigna: Elige la versión con verbos de la frase sobre las comidas gratuitas.
guiada.texto: The school's introduction of free lunches led to a rise in attendance, but the report never states who paid for them.
opciones: The school introduced free lunches, and more pupils began to attend.
The school introduced free lunches because more pupils had attended.
More pupils attended, so the school introduced free lunches.
guiada.feedback: Introduction vuelve a introduced, attendance a attend, y el orden causa-efecto se conserva: primero las comidas, después más asistencia.
guiada.pista: Busca el verbo escondido en introduction y en attendance, y respeta qué ocurrió primero.

guiada.consigna: Completa la versión verbal: «El ayuntamiento aprobó el plan tras semanas de debate.»
guiada.texto: Approval of the plan came only after weeks of debate. In other words, the council ___ the plan after weeks of debate, but the report does not say who proposed it.
guiada.feedback: Approval esconde el verbo approve; en pasado es approved y the council es el agente.
guiada.pista: Vuelve del sustantivo approval al verbo, en pasado.

guiada.consigna: Elige el verbo que esconde el sustantivo publication en la frase.
guiada.texto: A decrease in complaints followed the publication of the results, which the press described as a victory for accountability.
opciones: publish
public
publicly
guiada.feedback: Publication viene del verbo publish: alguien publicó los resultados, aunque la frase no diga quién.
guiada.pista: Quita la terminación del sustantivo y piensa en la acción.

practica.consigna: Completa cada versión verbal con el verbo escondido en el sustantivo.
frases: The closure of the shop upset many regulars. → The owner ___ the shop, and many regulars were upset.
The investigation of the fire took a week. → The police ___ the fire for a week.
The decrease in noise pleased the residents. → The noise ___, and the residents were pleased.
practica.feedback: Closure, investigation y decrease vuelven a closed, investigated y decreased.

practica.consigna: Escucha el informe y elige qué dato no se puede saber con lo que dice.
practica.audio: The introduction of the new parking charges led to a steady decrease in attendance at the market. Traders voiced concerns, and the publication of the council's figures, which showed a fall of twenty per cent, only increased the anger. Approval of the scheme had been given after a short discussion, and nobody has yet explained who was responsible. The council's refusal to reconsider has raised questions about accountability, and local businesses are now calling for an investigation into the decision.
opciones: Who was responsible for approving the scheme.
Whether the traders complained about the charges.
Whether the figures showed a fall in visitors.
practica.feedback: El informe dice que nadie ha explicado quién fue el responsable: si el texto no nombra al agente, no se puede inventar.

practica.consigna: Une cada frase densa con la acción que esconde, en español.
practica.feedback: Cada sustantivo esconde un verbo: introduce, publish, approve y attend.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué sugiere el autor al describir el cierre de la planta con tantos sustantivos?
evaluacion.texto: The publication of the findings led to an investigation and, later, the approval of new safety rules. At no point does the report say who first raised the alarm, and the closure of the plant is described throughout as a necessary step.
opciones: That the closure is presented as something that happened, not as a choice.
That the closure was a direct result of the new safety rules.
That the police delayed the approval of the new rules.
That the author wants readers to know who raised the alarm.
evaluacion.feedback: Con closure, approval y publication y sin agentes, el cierre parece un hecho inevitable y no una decisión de alguien; el texto no dice que las normas lo causaran.

evaluacion.consigna: Rehaz cada frase con el verbo que se esconde en su sustantivo.
frases: The introduction of a new timetable divided the staff. → The firm ___ a new timetable, and the staff were divided.
The complaint of the parents was heard at the meeting. → The parents ___ at the meeting.
The refusal of the owner to sell surprised everyone. → The owner ___ to sell, and everyone was surprised.
evaluacion.feedback: Introduction, complaint y refusal vuelven a introduced, complained y refused.

evaluacion.consigna: Escucha el pódcast y elige qué actitud adopta la locutora ante el estilo del artículo.
evaluacion.audio: The writer says that the closure of the clinic was sad but necessary. Notice what that phrase leaves out: nobody is named as having decided it. Her article is full of nouns such as closure, decrease and approval, and the effect is to make the decision sound like the weather, something that simply happened to the town.
opciones: She is suspicious: she thinks the style hides who is responsible.
She is impressed: she thinks the style keeps the tone fair and calm.
She is confused: she thinks the style makes the article hard to follow.
evaluacion.feedback: Dice que la decisión suena «like the weather»: sospecha de que los sustantivos dejen sin nombrar a quien decidió.

evaluacion.consigna: Ordena: «La publicación de los resultados provocó una discusión acalorada.»
evaluacion.respuesta: The publication of the results led to a heated discussion
evaluacion.feedback: El sujeto es The publication of the results; led to introduce el efecto, una discusión acalorada.

repaso.consigna: Escucha el relato y elige qué sugiere la directora con su respuesta.
repaso.audio: In the meeting, the director announced the closure of two shops. She said the decision had been taken after careful discussion, but she did not say by whom, and when a worker asked, she replied that the matter was closed. The room went quiet, and several people looked at the floor.
opciones: That she prefers not to say who made the decision.
That the workers had already decided the matter themselves.
That she does not know how the decision was reached.
repaso.feedback: Dice que la decisión se tomó tras una discusión, pero evita nombrar a nadie y cierra la pregunta: no quiere revelar quién decidió.

repaso.consigna: Reescribe la frase con verbos, usando el agente dado.
repaso.texto: Dato: el agente es the council. Reescribe con verbos: «The approval of the scheme followed a heated discussion and the publication of the figures.»
repaso.respuesta: The council discussed the scheme at length, published the figures and then approved it.
aceptadas: After a heated discussion, the council published the figures and approved the scheme.
The council argued about the scheme, published the figures and then approved the scheme.
repaso.feedback: Approval, discussion y publication vuelven a approved, discussed y published, con the council como agente y en el orden de los hechos.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Varios padres quisieron expresar sus preocupaciones sobre el nuevo horario.»
repaso.texto: Several parents decided to voice their ___ about the new timetable, and the head teacher promised to listen carefully.
repaso.feedback: Voice concerns es la colocación formal para expresar inquietudes en público.

classes.objetivo: Condensar un párrafo narrativo en un texto nominal de unas 60 palabras: convertir acciones en sustantivos, unir causa y efecto con caused, led to o due to y retomar con this delay.

ensenanza.en: A long delay in construction can give rise to anger among local families, especially when a shortage of builders is to blame.
ensenanza.es: Un retraso largo en la construcción puede dar lugar a enojo entre las familias del barrio, sobre todo si la culpa es de la escasez de constructores.
ensenanza.nota: delay y shortage condensan dos acciones; give rise to une causa y efecto como un verbo de causa formal.

ensenanza.en: The main consequence of the delay was a cost overrun, which seems to stem from a shortage of materials rather than poor planning.
ensenanza.es: La consecuencia principal del retraso fue un sobrecosto, que parece derivarse de la escasez de materiales y no de una mala planificación.
ensenanza.nota: consequence of + sustantivo; stem from presenta el origen de algo con cautela (seems to).

ensenanza.en: The council's investment in the library could contribute to a real change in the district, but only if the construction is finished on time.
ensenanza.es: La inversión del ayuntamiento en la biblioteca podría provocar un cambio real en el distrito, pero solo si la construcción termina a tiempo.
ensenanza.nota: investment + in; contribute to presenta la inversión como una de las causas, no la única.

ensenanza.en: In the wake of the delay, the outcome of the project was uncertain, although the final result was positive.
ensenanza.es: Tras el retraso, el resultado final del proyecto era incierto, aunque el balance fue positivo.
ensenanza.nota: in the wake of + grupo nominal sitúa un hecho como consecuencia de otro; outcome resume cómo terminó todo.

ensenanza.en: We can condense the whole story into one sentence: the late construction, due to a shortage of builders, angered local families.
ensenanza.es: Podemos condensar toda la historia en una frase: la construcción tardía, debida a la escasez de constructores, enojó a las familias del barrio.
ensenanza.nota: Condensar es juntar varias frases en una con grupos nominales y due to.

ensenanza.en: The builders were late; this delay, together with rising prices, forced the council to revise its investment plan.
ensenanza.es: Los constructores se retrasaron; este retraso, junto con la subida de precios, obligó al ayuntamiento a revisar su plan de inversión.
ensenanza.nota: this delay retoma lo anterior con un sustantivo resumen, sin repetir toda la frase.

explicacion.texto: Condensar es pasar de varias frases con verbos a una sola con grupos nominales. Receta: (1) convierte las acciones en sustantivos (the builders were late → the delay); (2) sustituye because y so por due to, in the wake of o verbos de causa (caused, led to, gave rise to, brought about); (3) retoma lo anterior con un sustantivo resumen (this delay, this shortage). Ahorras palabras sin perder datos, pero no abuses: dos o tres nominalizaciones por frase bastan, o el texto se vuelve pesado.

patron.texto: Sustantivo + verbo de causa + sustantivo (+ due to):

formula.nota: verbo de causa: sustituye a because y so

formula.texto: due to a shortage of builders.

filas.texto: The builders were late, so families were angry.
The builders' delay caused anger among families.
Because prices rose, people bought less.
The rise in prices led to a fall in purchases.
The council invested money, so more people visited.
The council's investment led to more visitors.

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The delay caused that families got angry.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The delay caused anger among families.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Con caused va un sustantivo (caused anger); «caused that» es un calco de «provocó que».

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The arrival late of the builders was the problem.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The late arrival of the builders was the problem.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: En inglés el adjetivo va delante del sustantivo: the late arrival, no «the arrival late».

situacion.contexto: Ana y Tom condensan un párrafo para el periódico del colegio.

dialogo.texto: My paragraph has two hundred words, and the editor wants sixty.
dialogo.traduccion: Mi párrafo tiene doscientas palabras y la editora quiere sesenta.

dialogo.texto: Start with the actions. The builders arrived late, so the library opened late.
dialogo.traduccion: Empieza por las acciones. Los constructores llegaron tarde, así que la biblioteca abrió tarde.

dialogo.texto: Delay is the noun for that. The delay in construction caused anger.
dialogo.traduccion: Delay es el sustantivo de eso. El retraso en la construcción causó enfado.

dialogo.texto: Good. Now add the reason: due to a shortage of builders.
dialogo.traduccion: Bien. Ahora añade el motivo: debido a la escasez de constructores.

item.consigna: ¿Qué hace Tom para reducir el párrafo de Ana?

opciones.es: Convierte las acciones en sustantivos como delay y shortage.
Elimina todos los datos del párrafo.

item.feedback: Tom propone sustituir «arrived late» por delay y añadir el motivo con «due to a shortage of builders».

guiada.consigna: Elige la versión condensada de la frase sobre los constructores.
guiada.texto: The builders were late, so the library opened two months behind schedule, and the families were angry about it.
opciones: The builders' delay caused a late opening of the library and anger among the families.
The builders' delay, due to the families' anger, caused a late opening of the library.
The late opening of the library, due to the builders, caused the families' delay and anger.
guiada.feedback: La versión correcta conserva la cadena causal (retraso, apertura tardía, enojo) con un sustantivo y un verbo de causa; las otras invierten quién causa qué.
guiada.pista: Comprueba que el retraso sea la causa y el enojo la consecuencia, no al revés.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «La falta de constructores calificados causó el retraso.»
guiada.texto: Work on the library fell behind schedule. A ___ of skilled builders was the main reason for the delay, and the council could not find replacements.
guiada.feedback: Shortage of condensa «no había suficientes constructores» en un grupo nominal.
guiada.pista: Versión con verbos: there were too few builders.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «El retraso en la construcción provocó enojo entre las familias del barrio.»
guiada.respuesta: The delay in construction gave rise to anger among local families
guiada.feedback: Sustantivo + verbo de causa + sustantivo: The delay … gave rise to … anger.
guiada.pista: Sustantivo de causa, verbo de causa y sustantivo de efecto.

practica.consigna: Une cada expresión condensada con su significado en español.
pares: due to a shortage of staff
in the wake of the delay
practica.feedback: Cada expresión condensada sustituye a una frase con because o so: causa, consecuencia u origen.

practica.consigna: Escucha la noticia y elige su versión condensada más fiel.
practica.audio: Last spring the builders were late because there were not enough workers. As a result, the library opened two months behind schedule. The families were angry and sent many complaints to the council. The council then spent more money than planned, but today the library is full of visitors, and the children read more than before.
opciones: A shortage of workers delayed the opening of the library, which caused anger and complaints but has led to more visitors and more reading.
A shortage of workers delayed the opening of the library, and the anger of the families led to more visitors and more reading.
Extra spending by the council delayed the opening of the library, which caused anger among families but brought more visitors in the end.
practica.feedback: La versión fiel conserva la causa real (la escasez de trabajadores) y el orden de los efectos; las otras atribuyen el retraso o las visitas a causas equivocadas.

practica.consigna: Ordena: «La inversión en la biblioteca provocó un aumento de visitantes.»
practica.respuesta: The investment in the library brought about a rise in visitors
practica.feedback: Investment es el sujeto nominal y brought about, el verbo de causa; a rise in visitors es el efecto.

evaluacion.consigna: Condensa el informe de la biblioteca en un texto nominal de unas 150 palabras.
evaluacion.texto: Two years ago the council decided to build a new library in our neighbourhood, and everybody was pleased. However, the builders were late because there were not enough skilled workers in the region, so the work fell behind schedule. As a result, the library opened two years late, and many families were angry and sent letters of complaint to the council. While they waited, the price of materials rose sharply, because the suppliers could not deliver on time, and the council had to pay the workers for extra months. In the wake of these problems, the newspaper asked why nobody had planned for the risk, and the council promised that it would investigate the matter. Finally, the library opened in September. The council had spent much more money than it had planned, but the result was good: every week more than a thousand people visit, and the children read much more than before. Looking back, the director says that the delay taught the council to plan more carefully, and that the families who complained deserve thanks, because their letters made the council act.
evaluacion.respuesta: The construction of the new neighbourhood library was delayed by two years, owing to a shortage of skilled workers in the region. This delay gave rise to anger among local families and to a wave of complaints addressed to the council. In the wake of these problems, a sharp rise in the price of materials, which stemmed from the suppliers' failure to deliver on time, led to a cost overrun, since the council also had to pay the workers for extra months. The newspaper's questions prompted the council to promise an investigation into the lack of planning. The outcome, however, has been positive: the opening of the library in September has brought about a steady increase in visitors, now above a thousand a week, and a marked improvement in the children's reading. In the director's view, the main consequence of the delay was a lesson in careful planning, and the families' complaints deserve credit for the council's response.
aceptadas: A shortage of skilled workers in the region caused a two-year delay in the construction of the new library, and the delay led to anger among families and to many complaints. The rise in the price of materials, due to late deliveries from the suppliers, resulted in a cost overrun, because the council had to pay the workers for extra months. After newspaper questions about the lack of planning, the council promised an investigation. The outcome is nevertheless good: since the opening in September, the number of visitors has risen above a thousand a week, and the children read much more than before. According to the director, the consequence of the delay has been better planning, and the families' complaints deserve thanks for the council's response.
evaluacion.feedback: Un buen texto condensado nombra el retraso y su causa, enlaza las consecuencias con verbos de causa o due to y conserva el resultado final, usando nominalizaciones.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué da a entender la directora sobre las quejas de las familias?
evaluacion.texto: It is easy to describe the delay as a failure, but the outcome tells a different story. The shortage of builders was beyond our control; the complaints of the families, however, were not, and they forced us to revise our planning. In that sense, the anger was a consequence we should have welcomed earlier.
opciones: That the complaints improved the council's planning, despite the anger.
That the council was to blame for the shortage of builders.
That the families should have complained much earlier in the project.
That the delay was a failure that nobody could have prevented.
evaluacion.feedback: Dice que las quejas obligaron a revisar la planificación y que el enojo fue una consecuencia que debió acogerse antes: valora su efecto positivo.

evaluacion.consigna: Completa: «El aumento de costos parece derivarse de la escasez de materiales.»
evaluacion.texto: The rise in costs seems to ___ from a shortage of materials rather than from poor planning, although the council has not yet confirmed this.
evaluacion.feedback: Stem from presenta la causa como origen probable; el seems to de la frase añade cautela.

evaluacion.consigna: Ordena: «El sobrecosto fue una consecuencia directa del largo retraso.»
evaluacion.respuesta: The cost overrun was a direct consequence of the long delay
evaluacion.feedback: The cost overrun es el sujeto; a direct consequence of + el retraso nombra la causa.

repaso.consigna: Escucha el discurso y elige qué actitud deja ver la alcaldesa.
repaso.audio: In her speech, the mayor said that the outcome was positive, but she added that the main consequence of the delay had been a loss of trust. She did not apologise; she said only that lessons had been learned, and she thanked the families for their patience.
opciones: She accepts that the delay did harm but avoids taking the blame.
She regrets the delay deeply and apologises to every family.
She denies that the delay caused any real problem at all.
repaso.feedback: Reconoce la pérdida de confianza, pero no pide disculpas y habla de lecciones aprendidas: admite el daño sin asumir la culpa.

repaso.consigna: Condensa en una sola frase, con un sustantivo de causa y due to o caused.
repaso.texto: Reescribe en una sola frase nominal: «The shop closed early because there were not enough staff, and the customers were angry about it.»
repaso.respuesta: The early closure of the shop, due to a shortage of staff, caused anger among customers.
aceptadas: A shortage of staff led to the early closure of the shop and to anger among customers.
The shop's early closure, owing to a lack of staff, gave rise to anger among the customers.
repaso.feedback: Closure condensa «closed» y due to a shortage of staff sustituye a because there were not enough staff; anger nombra la reacción.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Un sobrecosto así es muy habitual en el sector de la construcción.»
repaso.texto: The project went over budget by a lot, but such a cost ___ is hardly unusual in building work.
repaso.feedback: Cost overrun es la colocación para el gasto que supera lo previsto.

classes.objetivo: Resumir un artículo de divulgación con lenguaje nominal y explicarlo después en lenguaje llano, con verbos y personas.

ensenanza.en: The expansion of community gardens has transformed many European cities, and a growing body of evidence suggests that the change goes beyond appearance.
ensenanza.es: La expansión de los huertos comunitarios ha transformado muchas ciudades europeas, y un número creciente de pruebas sugiere que el cambio va más allá de la apariencia.
ensenanza.nota: expansion: el sustantivo de expand, ideal para abrir un resumen; a growing body of evidence introduce una conclusión con respaldo.

ensenanza.en: Participation in a garden brings neighbours together, and one researcher describes this social effect as a key finding of her study.
ensenanza.es: La participación en un huerto une a los vecinos, y una investigadora describe este efecto social como un hallazgo clave de su estudio.
ensenanza.nota: participation + in: nombra lo que hacen las personas como una idea; a key finding resalta el dato central.

ensenanza.en: Each gardener rents a small plot, but vacant land is scarce, so the council keeps a long waiting list.
ensenanza.es: Cada jardinero alquila una parcela pequeña, pero el terreno libre es escaso, así que el ayuntamiento mantiene una larga lista de espera.
ensenanza.nota: Esta frase ya es llana: sujeto, verbo y objeto concretos; scarce describe lo que falta.

ensenanza.en: The allocation of public land remains a sensitive matter, because the council must decide who receives a plot and who does not.
ensenanza.es: El reparto del suelo público sigue siendo un asunto delicado, porque el ayuntamiento debe decidir quién recibe una parcela y quién no.
ensenanza.nota: allocation of: nominalización que esconde quién reparte y a quién; la segunda parte la desmonta.

ensenanza.en: A good summary keeps the main facts, leaves out small details and avoids repeating the article's own words.
ensenanza.es: Un buen resumen conserva los datos principales, deja fuera los detalles pequeños y evita repetir las palabras del propio artículo.
ensenanza.nota: summary: lo que escribes al final; breve, con datos y sin ejemplos.

ensenanza.en: Once you have written the summary, explain it in plain English: people start gardens, so they feel less stressed.
ensenanza.es: Cuando hayas escrito el resumen, explícalo en inglés llano: la gente crea huertos, así que se siente menos estresada.
ensenanza.nota: in plain English: vuelve a los verbos y a las personas para que cualquiera lo entienda.

explicacion.titulo: Resumir y explicar en lenguaje llano
explicacion.texto: Resumir un artículo de divulgación es condensar sin perder los datos clave. Con lenguaje nominal: (1) localiza la idea principal (the expansion of community gardens); (2) convierte las acciones en sustantivos (participation, reduction, allocation); (3) une causa y efecto con led to o due to; (4) deja fuera ejemplos y detalles. Después, explícalo in plain English: vuelve a los verbos y a las personas (people start gardens, so they feel less stressed). Dominar los dos registros es la clave del inglés profesional.

patron.texto: Idea principal + efecto + límite, y luego versión llana:

formula.texto: has led to a reduction in stress,
although the allocation of land is limited.
In plain English: more people garden, so they feel less stressed.
formula.nota: versión llana con verbos y personas

filas.texto: More and more people start community gardens.
the council decides who gets the land

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: The expansion of community gardens has led a reduction in stress.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: The expansion of community gardens has led to a reduction in stress.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Led se une con to: led to + sustantivo (led to a reduction).

erroresFrecuentes.incorrecto: Gardeners feel better because their participation in gardens.
erroresFrecuentes.correcto: Gardeners feel better because of their participation in gardens.
erroresFrecuentes.explicacion: Because va delante de una oración; delante de un grupo nominal se usa because of.

situacion.contexto: Sara le explica a Leo el resumen que escribió sobre un artículo.

dialogo.texto: My summary says: The expansion of community gardens has led to a reduction in stress.
dialogo.traduccion: Mi resumen dice: La expansión de los huertos comunitarios ha llevado a una reducción del estrés.

dialogo.texto: That is dense. What does it mean in plain English?
dialogo.traduccion: Es denso. ¿Qué significa en inglés llano?

dialogo.texto: More people start gardens together, so they feel less stressed.
dialogo.traduccion: Más personas crean huertos juntas, así que se sienten menos estresadas.

dialogo.texto: And the problem?
dialogo.traduccion: ¿Y el problema?

dialogo.texto: The allocation of land: the council must decide who gets the plots.
dialogo.traduccion: El reparto del terreno: el ayuntamiento debe decidir quién recibe las parcelas.

item.consigna: ¿Qué hace Sara cuando Leo no entiende su resumen?

opciones.es: Lo explica de nuevo con verbos y dice quién decide.

item.feedback: Sara usa verbos y personas («people start gardens», «the council must decide») para explicar el resumen nominal.

guiada.consigna: Elige la versión llana de la frase sobre los huertos comunitarios.
guiada.texto: The expansion of community gardens has led to a reduction in stress, although the allocation of land remains difficult.
opciones: More people have started gardens and feel less stressed, but deciding who gets land is hard.
More gardens have caused extra stress, although the land is easy to share out.
Stress has fallen, so the council has started more gardens and shared the land.
guiada.feedback: Expansion, reduction y allocation vuelven a verbos y personas: la gente crea huertos, se estresa menos y alguien debe decidir el reparto.
guiada.pista: Vuelve de cada sustantivo al verbo y fíjate en qué es causa y qué es dificultad.

guiada.consigna: Completa: «La participación en el huerto une a los vecinos.»
guiada.texto: ___ in the garden brings neighbours together: people who had never spoken now share tools and advice every weekend.
guiada.feedback: Participation es el sustantivo de participate y abre la frase como sujeto.
guiada.pista: Es el sustantivo de participate y va con mayúscula al principio.

guiada.consigna: Ordena: «Cada jardinero recibe una parcela pequeña de terreno libre durante un año.»
guiada.respuesta: Each gardener receives a small plot of vacant land for a year
guiada.feedback: Each gardener es el sujeto, receives el verbo y a small plot of vacant land lo que recibe.
guiada.pista: Sujeto, verbo receives y después lo que recibe y el tiempo.

practica.consigna: Une cada frase nominal con su versión llana en español.
pares: cada vez más gente crea huertos
la gente se siente menos estresada
el ayuntamiento decide quién recibe el terreno
practica.feedback: Cada frase nominal se puede explicar con un verbo y una persona, o con un adjetivo como scarce.

practica.consigna: Escucha la noticia y elige qué advierte la investigadora.
practica.audio: The expansion of community gardens has led to a reduction in food costs for many families. One researcher, however, warns that the allocation of scarce land could divide neighbourhoods, unless councils explain their rules openly. In plain English: more people are growing their own food, and they save money, but there is not enough land for everybody, so somebody has to decide who gets it, and people must be able to trust that decision.
opciones: That unclear rules for sharing land could cause conflict.
That gardens will soon cost families more than they save.
That councils should stop giving out land for gardens.
practica.feedback: Advierte de que el reparto de un terreno escaso puede dividir a los vecinos si las reglas no se explican abiertamente.

practica.consigna: Completa: «Una investigadora que siguió a cuatrocientos jardineros halló menos estrés.»
practica.texto: A ___ who followed four hundred gardeners for two years found less stress among them, although she admits that some of them may have been calmer people to begin with.
practica.feedback: Researcher es la persona que investiga y publica los resultados de un estudio.

evaluacion.consigna: Resume el artículo en un texto nominal de unas 160 palabras.
evaluacion.texto: Community gardens are spreading fast through European cities. In the last ten years, thousands of neighbours have started to grow vegetables together on small plots of public land, and a growing body of evidence suggests that the benefits go well beyond fresh food. Researchers who followed four hundred gardeners for two years report a marked reduction in stress, and many families say that they now spend less money on food. Participation has also brought people together: in several districts, neighbours who had never spoken now share tools, seeds and advice. However, the expansion has a clear limit. Vacant land is scarce, and councils disagree about the allocation of the plots. Some want to give them first to schools, others to older residents, and a few argue that the places should go to whoever has waited longest. One researcher warns that the lack of a fair system could turn a popular project into a source of anger. A key finding of the study is that gardens work well when residents help to make the rules. The next step, she says, is a transparent system that every neighbour can understand and trust.
evaluacion.respuesta: The fast expansion of community gardens in European cities has led to a marked reduction in stress and in food costs for many families, according to a growing body of evidence. Researchers who followed four hundred gardeners for two years also found that participation brings neighbours together and encourages them to share tools, seeds and advice. However, this expansion is limited by a shortage of vacant land, and councils disagree about the allocation of plots: some would give priority to schools, others to older residents, and a few to whoever has waited longest. One researcher warns that the lack of a fair system could turn a popular project into a source of anger. A key finding of the study is that gardens work well when residents help to make the rules. The next step, therefore, is a transparent system for the allocation of land that every neighbour can understand and trust. In short, the gardens offer clear social and health benefits, but only a fair allocation of land will allow them to keep growing.
aceptadas: Community gardens are growing quickly in European cities, and researchers who followed four hundred gardeners report a reduction in stress and lower spending on food. Participation also brings neighbours together, since they share tools, seeds and advice. The expansion, however, is limited: vacant land is scarce, and councils cannot agree on the allocation of plots, because some prefer schools, others older residents and a few those who have waited longest. One researcher warns that the lack of a fair system could produce anger instead of cooperation. According to the study, gardens work well when residents help to make the rules, so the next step is a transparent system that everybody can understand and trust. A growing body of evidence suggests that the benefits of these gardens go well beyond fresh food.
evaluacion.feedback: Un buen resumen nominal nombra la expansión, el efecto (una reducción), la participación, el límite (falta de terreno y reparto) y el siguiente paso.

evaluacion.consigna: ¿Qué actitud muestra la autora ante el estudio sobre los huertos?
evaluacion.texto: The study is encouraging, but it should be read with caution. The gardeners were volunteers, so they may have been calmer people to begin with, and the researchers admit that they did not follow a comparison group. Even so, the reduction in stress is hard to ignore, and the evidence is growing.
opciones: Interested, but careful about what the results can prove.
Enthusiastic, and convinced that the study proves the benefits.
Doubtful, and ready to reject the conclusions of the study.
Dismissive, because the study is too small to matter.
evaluacion.feedback: Señala los límites (voluntarios, sin grupo de comparación) pero no descarta los resultados: interés con cautela.

evaluacion.consigna: Pasa cada frase llana a versión nominal con el sustantivo del paréntesis.
frases: The councils cannot agree, so the ___ over the plots continues. (disagree)
Gardens are growing fast, so the ___ of gardens is clear. (grow)
Stress is falling, so there is a ___ in stress. (reduce)
evaluacion.feedback: Disagree, grow y reduce dan disagreement, growth y reduction.

evaluacion.consigna: Ordena: «La escasez de terreno libre limita la expansión del proyecto.»
evaluacion.respuesta: A shortage of vacant land limits the expansion of the project
evaluacion.feedback: A shortage of vacant land es la causa y limits the expansion el efecto.

repaso.consigna: Escucha la explicación oral y elige qué sugiere sobre el reparto del terreno.
repaso.audio: In plain English: there is not much vacant land, so the council has to decide who can use it. Some councillors want to give plots to schools first, and others think older people should come first. Nobody has found a rule that everybody accepts, which is why the waiting list keeps growing.
opciones: That the lack of an accepted rule keeps the problem open.
That the council has already chosen schools over older people.
That the waiting list will end once more land is found.
repaso.feedback: Como nadie ha encontrado una regla aceptada por todos, la lista crece: el problema sigue sin resolverse.

repaso.consigna: Explica en lenguaje llano, con verbos y personas, la frase del artículo.
repaso.texto: Explica a un amigo, con verbos y personas: «The participation of neighbours has led to a decrease in loneliness, although the scarcity of vacant land limits further expansion.»
repaso.respuesta: More neighbours now take part in the gardens, so fewer of them feel alone. But there is not much vacant land, so the gardens cannot grow much more, and the council has to decide who gets a plot.
aceptadas: More people join the gardens now, and they feel less alone. The problem is that land is scarce, so the gardens cannot grow, and somebody must decide who gets a plot.
repaso.feedback: La versión llana cambia participation, decrease y scarcity por verbos y personas: neighbours take part, they feel less alone, the council decides.

repaso.consigna: Completa: «Un número creciente de pruebas sugiere que los huertos reducen el estrés.»
repaso.texto: A growing body of ___ suggests that time spent in community gardens reduces stress, although some of the studies are still very small.
repaso.feedback: A growing body of evidence es la colocación para un conjunto creciente de pruebas que apoyan una idea.
